description: UI modernization pass - Batch 2: Leads list, Bookings, and Clients pages. Apply the premium design system (rounded-xl cards, hover effects, colorful badges, transitions, generous spacing). Only change CSS classes - no logic/structure changes.
steps: In src/routes/_authenticated/leads/index.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On Cards (filter card, bulk action card, duplicate panels), add 'shadow-sm'. (3) On search Input, add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (4) On all Buttons, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On table rows in the lead list (TableRow), add 'hover:bg-accent/30 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On all Badge components, add 'rounded-full' where not already present. (7) Make pagination buttons have 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:shadow-sm'. (8) On the duplicate group items (rounded-lg border), change to 'rounded-xl' with 'hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (9) Timestamps/metadata to text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70 pattern where applicable.

In src/routes/_authenticated/bookings.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-6' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On the overdue alert Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (3) On the Table Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (4) On search Input, add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On Buttons (Bulk Upload, Open, Mark Paid), add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:shadow-sm'. (6) On Badge components, add 'rounded-full'. (7) On TableRows, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:bg-accent/30'. (8) Make the header h1 use 'text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold' (it currently uses text-2xl font-semibold).

In src/routes/_authenticated/clients.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-6' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On the top 3 stats Cards (p-4), add 'shadow-sm rounded-xl hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (3) On the table Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (4) On search Input, add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) On all Buttons, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On TierBadge components, add 'rounded-full'. (7) On TableRows, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (8) On the merge mode Card, add 'shadow-sm'. (9) Make header h1 consistent: 'text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold' (already correct).
acceptance_criteria: Running `bun run build` completes successfully with no TypeScript errors
Leads page has shadow-sm on cards, focus:ring-2 on inputs, transitions on buttons
Bookings page has rounded-full badges, shadow-sm cards, hover transitions on rows
Clients page stats cards have hover:shadow-md with smooth transitions
findings: Build passes cleanly. All CSS-only changes applied to leads/index.tsx, bookings.tsx, and clients.tsx. No logic changes made. Applied: shadow-sm on cards, focus:ring-2 on inputs, transition-all on buttons/rows, rounded-full on badges, hover effects on stat cards, p-5 md:p-10 page padding, rounded-xl on duplicate groups, text-[11px] for timestamps.
